lines.text: Many learners say: He married with her.

native.tip: marry の後ろに with は不要。直接人を置きます。
native.caption: “He married with her.”と言っていませんか？😅 「〜と結婚する」の「と」につられて with を入れがちです。“He married her.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“married”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say married her, with no with.
en.caption: Do you say this? “He married with her.” 😅 Do not add with after marry. The natural way is “He married her.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
